content.title: Protection

details.detail1: We offer advanced protection services including access control, strategic patrols, and escorts to ensure the security of your assets, people, and events.
details.detail2: Our security agents ensure rigorous control of access and exits, including key management, identity verification, and escorts for your specific needs.
details.detail3: Patrols adapted to each environment: whether static, mobile, or on foot, our teams ensure quick detection and response to any anomaly.
details.detail4: The presence of agents at each strategic point (storage, inventory, shipping) ensures optimal stock control.

content.approach: Ensure optimal security with our comprehensive protection solutions tailored to your needs.

steps.step1: Contact us to discuss your specific protection needs
steps.step2: We assess your situation and propose a tailored solution
steps.step3: We deploy a qualified security team
steps.step4: We ensure continuous monitoring and adapt our services according to your needs

question1.question: What types of events do you cover?
question1.answer: We cover all types of events, from small gatherings to large international events. Our team adapts to each situation to ensure optimal security.

question2.question: Do you offer escort services?
question2.answer: Yes, we provide escort services for personalities, VIPs, and valuable assets. Our agents are trained to ensure discreet and effective protection.

question3.question: How do you adapt your patrols according to needs?
question3.answer: Our patrols are customized according to your specific needs. We analyze your site, identify sensitive points, and establish an adapted surveillance plan.

content.title: Technology

details.detail1: Latlong International integrates the most modern technologies to enhance your security, including real-time tracking, alarm systems, and cybersecurity solutions.
details.detail2: We select and train highly qualified security agents in the use of advanced technologies such as GPS tracking systems and emergency alarm buttons.
details.detail3: Our technological infrastructure, such as smoke and intrusion detection systems, ensures permanent and reactive monitoring. Cybersecurity is at the heart of our priorities, with advanced solutions to protect your data and networks.

content.approach: Transform your security with cutting-edge technological solutions.

question1.question: Do your tracking systems work offline?
question1.answer: Yes, our equipment can operate in offline mode to ensure service continuity even in case of connection loss.

question2.question: Do you offer computer security services?
question2.answer: Absolutely, our solutions cover cybersecurity and digital infrastructure protection, with a specialized IT security team.

question3.question: Can you install systems in isolated areas?
question3.answer: Yes, we operate in various environments, including hard-to-reach sites, with solutions adapted to each situation.

content.title: Consultancy

details.detail1: Latlong International offers tailored consulting services to analyze your needs, design security strategies, and effectively manage crises.
details.detail2: Our comprehensive security assessments identify potential vulnerabilities to anticipate threats.
details.detail3: Custom evacuation and crisis management strategies ensure a rapid and coordinated response.
details.detail4: Our experts collaborate with your teams to ensure optimal preparation, including health and safety, investigations, and comprehensive audits.

content.approach: A solid strategy is the key to successful security. We can guide you through it.

question1.question: Do you offer comprehensive security audits?
question1.answer: Yes, we conduct on-site audits with concrete and detailed recommendations to improve your security.

question2.question: Do your crisis management plans include practical exercises?
question2.answer: Absolutely, we organize regular simulations to test and improve your teams' responsiveness.

question3.question: How long does a security assessment take?
question3.answer: It depends on the site size and complexity of needs, but generally, a complete assessment can be completed within 1 to 2 weeks.

content.title: Training

details.detail1: Latlong International offers specialized training to raise awareness, prepare, and strengthen your teams' skills in risk situations.
details.detail2: We focus on prevention and intelligence gathering to anticipate threats before they materialize.
details.detail3: Our training includes sessions on first aid, defensive driving, and crisis security management.
details.detail4: Our programs are tailored to each client to meet the specific needs of their environment and sector.

content.approach: Be ready to face security challenges with our professional and practical training programs.

steps.step1: Identify your training needs with our team
steps.step2: Choose from our training catalog or request a customized program
steps.step3: Schedule sessions according to your availability
steps.step4: Participate in on-site or online training

question1.question: Are your training programs certified?
question1.answer: Yes, all our training programs include certification recognized by competent authorities and professional organizations in the sector.

question2.question: Can you train large teams?
question2.answer: Absolutely, we can adapt our training to groups of any size, with personalized programs to ensure optimal quality.

question3.question: Do you offer on-site training?
question3.answer: Yes, our teams can travel to provide training directly at your location, allowing for better adaptation to your work environment.

content.title: Other Security Services

details.detail1: Latlong International offers a wide range of services, from firefighting to secure transportation, to complement your security strategy.
details.detail2: Our cash transportation and emergency evacuation service ensures the security of your assets and personnel in all situations.
details.detail3: We provide advanced surveillance solutions, including energy resource management with modern systems.
details.detail4: Our specially trained K-9 units bring additional expertise for detection and protection.

content.approach: Comprehensive security with complementary solutions tailored to your specific needs.

steps.step1: Contact us to express your specific needs
steps.step2: Receive a comprehensive assessment of your situation
steps.step5: Get continuous support to ensure the effectiveness of implemented solutions

question1.question: Do you offer firefighting services?
question1.answer: Yes, our teams are trained to respond quickly in case of fire, with appropriate equipment and proven procedures.

question2.question: Are your K-9 units available for private events?
question2.answer: Absolutely, our specially trained dogs can be deployed for specific events, providing additional and deterrent security.

question3.question: Can you manage surveillance of remote sites?
question3.answer: Yes, our solutions are designed to work even in remote or challenging environments, with autonomous systems and mobile teams.

content.title: Our guiding principles
content.intro: At Latlong, we are committed to maintaining the highest ethical standards in all our operations. Our guiding principles form the foundation of our professional approach and our commitment to excellence.

integrity.title: Integrity and transparency
integrity.description: We operate with complete transparency in all our interactions. Every decision is made in compliance with applicable laws and fundamental ethical principles. Our commitment to integrity is reflected in clear and honest communication with our clients, transparent resource management, strict adherence to established procedures, and immediate disclosure of any conflict of interest.

humanRights.title: Respect for human rights
humanRights.description: The protection and respect of human rights are at the heart of our operations. We are committed to training our teams on fundamental human rights, ensuring proportionate and respectful intervention, protecting the dignity of all concerned persons, and reporting and addressing any human rights violations.

excellence.title: Professional excellence
excellence.description: Our commitment to excellence is demonstrated through continuous training of our teams, the use of industry best practices, innovation in our intervention methods, and regular evaluation of our performance.

author.name: Latlong International
author.description: These principles are not mere statements, but concrete commitments that we implement daily. Every member of our team is trained and encouraged to adhere to these values, ensuring consistency across all our operations.

content.title: Our CSR commitment
content.intro: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is at the heart of our strategy at Latlong. We are committed to positively contributing to the sustainable development of our community while maintaining high standards of professional performance.

1.title: Social impact
1.description: Our social commitment is demonstrated through several initiatives: local training and employment (95% of our workforce is recruited locally), professional training programs for youth, partnerships with local educational institutions, and support for community initiatives.

2.title: Environment
2.description: Our environmental commitment includes reducing our carbon footprint, responsible waste management, using eco-friendly technologies, and raising awareness among our teams about sustainable practices.

3.title: Governance
3.description: Our responsible governance approach includes transparency in our operations, ethical business practices, respect for employee rights, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

4.title: 2024-2025 objectives
4.description: We aim to increase local recruitment by 20%, reduce energy consumption by 15%, train 100 young people in security professions, and launch 3 new community projects.

author.name: Latlong International
author.description: Our CSR commitment is an integral part of our corporate identity. We firmly believe that our success is linked to our ability to create a positive impact on society and the environment.

content.title: General terms of use
content.intro: These general terms govern the use of Latlong International SARL services. By using our services, you accept these terms in full.

1.title: Services and commitments
1.description: Latlong commits to providing professional security services in compliance with international standards, respecting agreed deadlines in contracts, maintaining client information confidentiality, and ensuring continuous staff training.

2.title: Client obligations
2.description: Clients commit to providing accurate and complete information, respecting established payment terms, cooperating with our security personnel, and reporting any incidents or concerns.

3.title: Confidentiality and data protection
3.description: We commit to protecting personal data in accordance with the law, limiting access to sensitive information, informing clients of their rights, and implementing appropriate security measures.

4.title: Responsibilities and limitations
4.description: Our liability is limited to cases of proven professional misconduct, non-compliance with established procedures, and breach of contractual obligations.

author.name: Latlong International
author.description: Latlong reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes take effect upon publication on our website. We encourage our clients to regularly consult this page to stay informed of changes.

content.title: Our Code of Conduct
content.subtitle: Latlong International – Security with Values
content.intro: At Latlong, our operations are guided by six essential values: Passion, Respect, Environment, Integrity, Discipline, and Excellence. These principles reflect our identity and structure every action we take—on the ground and in partnership.

1.title: Professional commitment
1.description: We act with pride and dedication in every task. Our personnel maintain a professional appearance, respect internal procedures and hierarchy, and are committed to delivering high-quality services with care and efficiency.

2.title: Ethics & integrity
2.description: All Latlong team members uphold the highest standards of honesty, avoid conflicts of interest, and refuse any form of bribery or undue advantage. Confidentiality and transparency are not optional—they are essential.

3.title: Respect for clients and communities
3.description: Our relationships are built on mutual respect, courtesy, and cultural sensitivity. We ensure the protection of our clients' data and apply strict confidentiality and security protocols across all missions.

4.title: Legal and social responsibility
4.description: Latlong complies with national and international regulations, human rights standards, and environmental responsibilities. We actively promote fair recruitment, inclusion, and social upliftment wherever we operate.

download.title: Discover how these principles are applied in every aspect of our operations by downloading our full Code of Conduct:

author.name: Latlong International
author.description: Non-compliance with this Code of Conduct may result in disciplinary measures, up to and including contract termination. Each employee receives training on this code and must sign it upon joining.

content.title: Our ICoCA Commitment
content.intro: Latlong International is proud to be a member of the International Code of Conduct Association (ICoCA), a multi-stakeholder initiative that promotes, governs, and oversees the implementation of the International Code of Conduct for Private Security Service Providers.

1.title: Our commitments
1.description: We provide continuous training for our agents on ICoCA standards, implement integrated due diligence procedures, ensure accessible and secure complaint mechanisms, conduct regular audits of our operations, and actively report any potential Code violations.

2.title: For our clients
2.description: Choosing an ICoCA-affiliated provider means benefiting from a high level of international compliance, ethical operational management, and enhanced transparency through robust reporting.

3.title: Our ICoCA certificate
3.description: Download the certificate (PDF). Issued on January 24, 2025 – Valid until January 31, 2026.

author.name: Latlong International
author.description: Our ICoCA membership reflects our commitment to excellence and ethics in the private security sector. We are determined to maintain and continuously improve our standards to meet the most stringent international requirements.
